checks.label: Every measurement has a unit
checks.method: Measurements in the five app scenario bundles (S1-S4 exported from the replay, S5 fixture); 'UNVERIFIED' counts as no unit

checks.label: Timestamps are in order
checks.method: Decode start before end and end minus start equal to the monotonic elapsed time; stimulus before response; schedule start before end; follow-up opened before its review date; reference period before its target date

checks.label: Rule, reference, protocol and scenario versions are recorded
checks.method: Status ruleset, reference version, finding rule version, Decode protocol, key and app version, scenario version

checks.label: Records match the data contract
checks.method: Each record in the five app scenario bundles (S1-S4 exported from the replay, S5 fixture) against contracts/*.schema.json

checks.label: ID and realm rules hold in every bundle
checks.method: scripts/validate_data.py rules: unique IDs, one realm per subject, no cross-realm links, provenance matches realm

checks.label: Decode scores recomputed from their response ledgers
checks.method: science/decode.py verify() on every replayed session with the capture seal; stored summary equals the recomputed one

checks.label: Stored information statuses reproduced by the status engine
checks.method: science/status.py evaluate() on each record of the exported S1-S4 bundles with its subject and ledger context

checks.label: Hand-made S5 fixture statuses reproduced by the status engine
checks.method: Same check on the hand-made S5 fixture; its Decode sessions carry no response events, so the engine cannot verify them (listed in science/tests/test_fixtures_status.py)

checks.label: Role permission tests
checks.method: Run by the app test suite (app/src/store/permissions.test.ts, npm test); this script does not run TypeScript tests

checks.label: Resending a summary creates no duplicate
checks.method: Run by the app test suite (app/src/sync, npm test); this script does not run TypeScript tests

checks.label: Shared test vectors reproduced in Python
checks.method: science/contract_logic.py on every file in contracts/vectors/ (score_decode, build_reference, compare_to_reference, rest_opportunity), tolerance from each file

checks.label: Training and held-out sets share no member and no day
checks.method: Training member sim:crew:04 on days before 2026-11-20; held-out members sim:crew:01, sim:crew:02, sim:crew:03 on 2026-11-20 only

checks.label: Personal references use earlier days only
checks.method: Every source record of every replayed reference candidate (science/reference.py) is dated before the target day

checks.label: The reference does not absorb the S1 decline
checks.method: S1 Decode reference has a freeze decision, the follow-up is open, and today's session is not among its sources

checks.label: Simulated changes found by the personal reference on held-out members
checks.method: Training member sim:crew:04 on days before 2026-11-20; held-out members sim:crew:01, sim:crew:02, sim:crew:03 on 2026-11-20 only; a simulated change is a replay member whose fixture sets today's median_correct_rt_ms apart from its history; found = the rules engine reports a descriptive change against the personal reference

checks.label: Flags on held-out member-days without a simulated change
checks.method: Training member sim:crew:04 on days before 2026-11-20; held-out members sim:crew:01, sim:crew:02, sim:crew:03 on 2026-11-20 only; personal reference

checks.label: Simulated changes found by one fixed band for everyone
checks.method: Training member sim:crew:04 on days before 2026-11-20; held-out members sim:crew:01, sim:crew:02, sim:crew:03 on 2026-11-20 only; flagged when outside the fixed band

checks.label: Fixed-band flags without a simulated change
checks.method: Training member sim:crew:04 on days before 2026-11-20; held-out members sim:crew:01, sim:crew:02, sim:crew:03 on 2026-11-20 only; flagged when outside the fixed band

checks.label: Days the personal reference flags before the fixed band, median
checks.method: Over hits flagged by both methods; the replay scores one later day per member, so the lead can only be 0

checks.label: Held-out member-days that could not be scored
checks.method: A session whose information status is not valid (for example interrupted) is never scored

checks.label: Fixed band for everyone, upper edge (median_correct_rt_ms)
checks.method: One fixed band for everyone: min-max of the training member's 10 valid session medians before 2026-11-20 = 620-620 ms

checks.label: Daily check time, median
checks.method: Not computable: the replay stores one submission time for each of its 4 daily checks and no start time; the 3-minute target (NFR-02) needs the timed hallway test

checks.label: Decode round length from its timestamps, median
checks.method: End minus start UTC of every completed replayed session

checks.label: Findings per member-month in the replay
checks.method: 11 findings over 28 simulated member-days (30 days = one month); every finding kind counts

checks.label: Follow-ups completed in the scenarios
checks.method: Replay follow-ups S1-S4 with status closed; the scenarios end while follow-ups are open
